short: ABS brake booster & master cylinder assembly for Mitsubishi Pajero 3rd gen (2000–2006, V60/V70). Complete unit, ready to fit. Order on WhatsApp in UAE.
description:
Looking for a Mitsubishi Pajero ABS brake booster and master cylinder in the UAE? Al Kaffa Parts supplies parts for the Pajero 3rd generation (2000 – 2006, V60 / V70), with fitment checked by your VIN before you buy.

Is your brake pedal hard, spongy or slow to return, or is the ABS warning light on? On the Pajero the hydraulic brake booster and ABS actuator are one unit, and when it wears out the whole braking feel suffers. This complete assembly replaces it in one go.

Features

  • Hydraulic brake booster with built-in ABS actuator
  • Master cylinder and brake fluid reservoir already fitted
  • Original-style electrical connectors – plugs straight into the factory wiring
  • Pushrod and clevis included for the brake pedal
  • Checked and ready to install

What is included

Brake booster / ABS actuator, master cylinder, fluid reservoir with cap, pushrod with clevis.

Fits

Mitsubishi Pajero 3rd generation (2000 – 2006, V60 / V70) with ABS.

Bleed the brake system fully after fitting. Our team can advise on the correct brake fluid for your Pajero.

How to order

Tap Order on WhatsApp or message +971 50 124 9137 with your VIN (chassis number) or a photo of your old part. We confirm the fitment and send you the price, then deliver to your door. Pay cash on delivery.
